recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. No core follow-up is needed unless active Java model sources return to this checkout; any equivalent future Java-library behavior issue should be handled in the maintained Java tooling/library repository.
issue_request: FHIR-19785 is a Published/Persuasive technical correction asking to restore the earlier GF#19646/FHIR-19646 fix after commit 4791afa regenerated the R4 Java Narrative.java file and reintroduced new XhtmlNode() construction without an explicit NodeType, causing IG Publisher Null node type failures.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to git a2cd91464e. History shows 4791afa changed Narrative.div auto-creation back from new XhtmlNode(NodeType.Element, "div") to new XhtmlNode(), and a2cd91464e4d9e665663cfc5764779c78c210166 restored new XhtmlNode(NodeType.Element, "div") in implementations/java/org.hl7.fhir.r4/src/org/hl7/fhir/r4/model/Narrative.java.
additional_context: FHIR-19785 is the restore companion to FHIR-19646, whose prior reconciliation commit eb817a3027a439ef77d2e0214bd48e5358b21249 audited the same retired Java narrative fix family and found that the affected Java implementation files had been moved out of active source and deleted. The current checkout has zero Java files, no Narrative.java/BaseNarrative.java/XhtmlNode.java paths, and no active fhir.ini reference to the old Java implementation tree. FHIR-I minutes from 2020-01-27 record FHIR-19785 with 'Grahame: Yes, this is fixed,' and community searches found no conflicting current-source decision.
reconciliation: Created an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because there is no current in-scope FHIR core source file corresponding to the retired Java Narrative.java path.

related_jiras.note: Original Null node type fix that FHIR-19785 restored after R4 model regeneration overwrote the Narrative.java hunk. It is already represented on the combined branch by eb817a3027a439ef77d2e0214bd48e5358b21249.
